questions.prompt:
Official NSC · Nov 2022 · English First Additional Language Paper 1 · Question 1.1

Choose the grammatically correct sentence.

options.text: She don't understand the homework.
She aren't understanding the homework.
She doesn't understand the homework.
She not understand the homework.

questions.explanation: FAL Paper 1: subject–verb agreement and correct auxiliary verbs are examined.

questions.prompt:
Official NSC · Nov 2022 · English First Additional Language Paper 1 · Question 1.2

The headline of a news article primarily helps the reader to —

options.text: identify the author's favourite hobby
count the number of paragraphs
ignore the main idea
predict the main topic before reading

questions.explanation: Reading comprehension: headlines orient the reader to topic and purpose.

questions.prompt:
Official NSC · Nov 2022 · English First Additional Language Paper 1 · Question 1.3

Which greeting is MOST suitable for a formal letter to a school principal?

options.text: Dear Principal Mokoena
Hey Principal!!!
Yo Mokoena
What's up?

questions.explanation: Register: formal letters use appropriate salutation and tone.
